A1

Ablation Studies (cont.)

Sensitivity of τscale . Considering τscale is an important hyperparameter that
controls the effect of constraining sensitive rank components, we analyze its
impact on ACC and ASR to determine the best suitable setting. As shown in
Fig. A1, when τscale is within the range of [4, 5], ASR is steadily reduced with
high ACC as τscale decreases, and further smaller τscale out of this range causes
considerable ACC drop. Therefore, in our experiments τscale is set as 4.

Sensitivity of γ. We study the impact of γ in and show results in Table A1. It
is seen too high or low γ brings unsatisfied ACC or ASR. Therefore, γ is set as
1 in our experiments for the best performance.
